0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons visit the Brooklyn Nets in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A regular-season game, the Pistons' sixth of the season. Detroit comes in at 4-1, first in the Central and first in the East, with a win in its last game, while Brooklyn is 0-4, has lost four straight, and sits 5th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back. Detroit's Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain, and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and is a game-time decision, while Brooklyn's Egor Demin is out with a leg bruise, Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder sprain, and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with an illness and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
